trans-unit.source: Which LLM configuration and which DeepL key this site's AI calls use. Empty fields use the installation's.

Identifier of the LLM configuration this site's AI calls use when the calling extension has not chosen one itself. Empty: the installation default. A configuration that does not exist, is disabled or is restricted to backend groups makes the call fail instead of using the default.

Identifier of the nr-vault secret that holds this site's DeepL key, not the key itself. Empty: the key of the extension configuration. A Free key (ending in ":fx") is sent to the Free endpoint unless the extension configuration sets a base URL.

The URL under which this site answers A2A requests from registered remote agents, for example https://www.example.org/a2a. The agent card is published at this URL plus /.well-known/agent-card.json. Empty: the site answers no A2A request. The server role must also be switched on in the extension configuration.
